findings.message: B1: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.clamp: Use the nest's integrated supported fingers at X+/-30 only for light manual edge deburring; tighten against clean supported strap without bending. Secure nest base to the bench before applying hand force.
hold.note: DEMONSTRATION mechanical hold for op 10 using the existing finished-strap nest, not a padded tray as cutting restraint. No added pad thickness is assumed. Inspect access before deburring: support the arm and release/reseat one finger at a time to expose its contact patch, retighten before applying hand force; do not pry or abrade under clamps. Stop if full edge access cannot be obtained without distortion. For coating transport and op 30, remove from the nest onto a clean padded handling tray; mask and send to finisher with traceable batch identity. Actual finisher holding and qualified datum simulation remain commissioning obligations, not asserted by this nest pose.
hold.stop: Seat the finished strap underside on the nest pads with the lower hub projection free in the dia 12 through relief; register actual bore centre without loading the bore.

findings.subject: B1

findings.message: D1: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.clamp: Supported strap fingers at X+/-30; rod end supported, not clamped into bow.
hold.note: Strap underside on integral distributed pads, dia 12 relief for lower hub, sacrificial pad directly beneath rod hole. DEMONSTRATION rod-drilling nest. Touch local strap entry atZ0, not proud hub top; drill point/exit enters sacrificial pad, not metal fixture.
hold.stop: Indicate actual A, clock current profile symmetry about X without inventing C before drilling.

supports.note: DEMONSTRATION independent table-aligned base: nominated example central T-slot attachment and recessed M6 fixture mounts; use matching clocking pattern, torque and verify seating before pickups. Not a vendor observation.
